headline: Meta and Apple team up on Muse Spark Open AI model
summary: Meta launched its Muse Spark Open AI model, calling it the most capable US open-weight model to date, built to run locally on Apple silicon; one outlet notes it needs 1TB of RAM to run on two Mac Studios.

claims.statement: Meta launched the Muse Spark Open AI model, which runs on Mac/Apple silicon.

sources.quote: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
Meta announced the Muse Spark Open AI model today
Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon

claims.statement: Meta says Muse Spark Open is the most capable US open-weight model to date.

sources.quote: Muse Spark Open is "the most capable US open-weight model to date," the company says.
claiming that it's the "most capable US open-weight model to date

claims.statement: The model can run on a desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with the latest MLX framework.

claims.statement: Running the model requires 1TB of RAM.

sources.quote: Meta built a huge open-weight AI model for Macs, but you'll need 1TB of RAM to run it
